newsitem.title: USA: U.S. poultry cos to form venture with Russian firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. poultry cos to form venture with Russian firm.

text.p: U.S. poultry companies plan to form a joint venture with a Russian partner and will invest several million dollars to develop a working model that can be used by other Russian poultry operations, industry groups said.

The project is being mounted by the National Broiler Council and the USA Poultry & Egg Export Council and will be funded by industry contributions. The groups said support was also expected from the U.S. government through various existing programs and loans from international financial organizations.
The Russian poultry partner has not been selected.

"The American poultry industry wants a long-term cooperative relationship with Russia -- not just a short term trade relationship," James Sumner, president of the USA Poultry & Egg Export Council said in a statement.
